narrative.rotation_signal: Clear accumulation in mega-cap tech (MSFT, GOOG, META, AMZN, INTC), memory/semi-cap equipment (MU, AMAT), and money-center banks (BAC, C, WFC). Distribution concentrated in JPM, AVGO/AMD, energy (XOM), and select industrials/staples (CAT, PG, JNJ) — suggesting a quality-tech-plus-banks barbell rather than broad risk-on.
